metadata.notes: Minimal tool entity, added 2026-08-13 so data/actions/grate.json's requiredTools reference resolves — same minimal-tool precedent as knife.json/masher.json. Deliberately NOT reused for CUT: grating shreds by friction against a grating surface, a physically different mechanical action from a knife's slicing motion, so it gets its own tool and verb rather than becoming a shape value on CUT — see potato.json's gratedNote.
